sourceFacts.reviewScope: Complete static medium-fi exterior of the seven-tier gate tower, including both passage facades, eight lower attached columns, small north/south stair doors, round vent indications, three square terraces, two octagonal chambers, eight-sided brick tent, upper watch chamber and long green spire with apple and crescent. Original detailed source remains reproducible. The lower envelope follows the attributed OSM outline, while the architectural field study supplies the 6.90 m passage; the previous sqrt(140) square shaft is preserved only in the original draft. Museum Russian and English pages report different base areas (140 and 147 m²); neither defines whether the passage or projections are counted, so these values do not certify the reconstructed rectangular dimensions. Upper widths, window heights, decorative panels and the tapered north reinforcement are proportional interpretations of exterior photography and published descriptions, not a measured restoration survey. The 1.98 m NE lean is a linear exterior shear. Gate bars and sun/crescent motifs are simplified; mythological figures, individual brick damage, inscriptions, interiors, foundations and adjacent independent palace gates are outside this static exterior scope. Four tiny tent vents are closed dark geometric indications, not openings into an interior. The canonical normally restored crescent is retained despite its temporary removal announced 6 October 2026. No downloaded reference mesh or photograph is embedded or redistributed. Two common material graphs supply brick and painted metal; the small gilded ornaments use a warm stylized tint. Physical phone/laptop timings and host terrain contact remain unmeasured.
sourceFacts.reinforcement: North tapered exterior support, proportional interpretation

appearance.identity: Seven-tier leaning brick gate tower of the Kazan Kremlin: open vaulted gate, pylon columns, recessed shirinka parapets, square gallery stages, octagonal upper chambers, tall faceted brick tent and green spire with gilded crescent.
appearance.master: Complete reviewed seven-tier exterior; original detailed recipe preserved.
appearance.browser: Four whole-building levels retaining the broad lower pylons, through passage, small stair doors, all seven tiers, NE lean and usual green crescent spire.

geographic.evidence: Attributed cached OSM way228963085 for Q2166466, captured2026-09-27T16:21:24.079Z, establishes the lower18.02 by12.88m envelope and anchor[49.105181097,55.800475854]. Actual north-up satellite pixels inspected2026-10-09 confirm the tower beside the palace gates and the west/east passage direction. Heading−1.335984319155rad maps native+Z west/slightly south and+X north/slightly east. The published north wall reinforcement resolves the otherwise symmetric half-turn; the authored NE lean is transformed from geographic coordinates. Approximate2m position and5° angular uncertainty cover generalized outline, roof displacement and photo-fitted projections. The museum reference GLB was inspected only as uncalibrated cross-sections: its broad rectangular lower pylons support rejecting the draft square assumption, but its dimensions are not treated as surveyed. The accepted lower source envelope fits the mapped frame; recorded140/147m² public figures remain an unresolved dimensional interpretation, not a reason to stretch the original square invisibly.
geographic.limitations: Map and satellite placement within approximately2m and5°. Full exterior bounds include interpreted cornices and north reinforcement. Ground0 is nominal contact; terrain and foundations are not surveyed.
